name: StockRoom POS
note: Answer key for scripts/benchmark.py only. The QA Pilot engine must never read this file.

bugs.title: Stock can go negative
bugs.description: A sale with quantity larger than the stock on hand is accepted and stock becomes negative.

bugs.title: Removed product still selectable in sales
bugs.description: 'Caramel Popcorn (discontinued)' is removed from sale but is offered and sellable in New sale.

bugs.title: Cashier can open the profit report
bugs.description: Profit report is admin-only in the menu but cashiers can open /reports/profit by URL.

bugs.title: VAT is 1.5% instead of 15%
bugs.description: Sales add 1.5% VAT although the app states VAT is 15%.

bugs.title: Receiving a purchase does not increase stock
bugs.description: Recording a purchase says 'stock received' but the product's stock is unchanged.

bugs.title: Profit report uses selling price as cost
bugs.description: Cost of goods sold = qty × selling price, so gross profit is always $0.00.

bugs.title: Zero or negative selling price accepted
bugs.description: A product can be saved with price 0 or -5.

bugs.title: Duplicate SKU accepted
bugs.description: Two products can share the same SKU.

bugs.title: Cashier can edit product prices via URL
bugs.description: /products/<id>/edit is not restricted to admins; a cashier can change prices.

bugs.title: Help center link is broken
bugs.description: Footer 'Help center' returns 404 on every page.

bugs.title: JavaScript error on Dashboard
bugs.description: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'height').

bugs.title: Icon-only buttons without accessible names
bugs.description: The ✎ edit link on Products and the 🖨 print button on a sale have no accessible name.

bugs.title: Products table overflows on mobile
bugs.description: The products table is fixed at 1100px with no scroll container.

bugs.title: Refunded sale can be refunded again
bugs.description: 'Refund sale' is offered and works for an already refunded sale, adding the items to stock again.

bugs.title: Low-stock alert misses low products
bugs.description: Dashboard says 'Low stock (< 5)' but only lists products with 0 stock (Sea Salt Crisps with 3 and Greek Yogurt with 2 are missing).
